snippet.title: Muh Quest trailer - Mobile adventure game launch promo video
snippet.description:
*For best quality, switch to 1080p in the settings.

Casual adventure game where the main character is you!

Choose your first outfit and begin along your quest! 62 levels with 40 more bonus levels available. 

Get it from Google Play for Android or The App Store for iOS!

Thanks for checking out the game. More updates coming soon.

Muh Quest launch trailer promo video.

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/muh-quest/id6745513624

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.SmartSmartPhonesLtd.MuhQuest
